categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Hanyi Innovation Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in font library software authorization, internet platform authorization, font library technical services, other technical services, and IP products and licensing. The company also engages in cultural and artistic design related to Chinese characters, including exhibitions and derivative products. It serves both B-end (enterprise) and C-end (consumer) markets with a focus on digital font products and personalized digital content.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI technologies including AI font generation, AI font recognition, and machine learning for font design and production. It has developed proprietary cloud-based collaborative font design platforms and intelligent font management software. The use of Transformer architectures and machine creative design algorithms enhances font style generation and cross-language font migration. The company also integrates vector font and multi-layer rendering technologies for icon fonts and develops AI-driven marketing content platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large enterprises in retail, IT, internet, finance, and food & beverage sectors, as well as mobile terminal manufacturers like Huawei, OPPO, Vivo, and Xiaomi. The company serves digital media, publishing, advertising, gaming, mobile apps, and smart devices markets. It also targets individual designers and small businesses through subscription-based font management platforms. International markets are addressed through multilingual font products and overseas font management services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and major offices in Beijing and Shanghai. It has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Xiamen, and serves international markets including Europe and the Americas through overseas font management platforms and multilingual font products. Its global language font design capabilities cover Latin, Cyrillic, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, and other scripts.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Hanyi Innovation Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital content and font industry supply chain. It develops and licenses font software and provides related technical services and digital content solutions directly to end users and enterprises, as well as through internet platforms.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes integration of traditional Chinese culture with advanced AI and digital technologies. Key R&D directions include AI-driven font generation and recognition, cross-language font style migration, intelligent font management, and AI-powered marketing content automation. It invests heavily in expanding multilingual font libraries and enhancing user experience on digital platforms. The company also pursues industry consolidation and international expansion, alongside developing cultural IP and immersive digital exhibitions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through font library software licensing to enterprises, subscription fees from internet platform users, customized font design services, and IP product sales and licensing. Additional income comes from technical services, cultural product sales, and rental income. The company also earns from financial investments and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the Chinese font library industry, competing primarily with Founder Group and other domestic font providers. It holds a strong market position due to its extensive font product portfolio, advanced AI capabilities, and broad customer base. Strategic investments and industry consolidation efforts aim to strengthen its competitive edge and market influence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 190.7 million, a 12.17% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 8.8 million, down 78.74%. Despite revenue decline, the company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 1.2 billion and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenses accounting for over 22% of revenue. The company’s internet platform authorization business showed growth, and it is expanding its consumer market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through a rich and diverse font library with over 1,700 proprietary fonts and 3,600 font sets, advanced AI-driven font design and recognition technologies, and comprehensive font management platforms. It integrates traditional Chinese cultural elements with modern digital technology, offering customized multilingual font solutions and innovative IP products. Its subscription-based model and AI tools enhance user experience and operational efficiency, positioning it as a technology-driven cultural innovator.
